title: Problem definition and parameter source audit
purpose: Establish what the current engineering problem actually is, which facts are supported by current evidence, and which facts must be requested or explicitly treated as assumptions.
engineering_questions: What physical object and response are being studied?
Which geometry, material, load and boundary-condition facts are established by current inputs?
Which values are missing, ambiguous, conflicting or inherited from another version?

evidence_requirements.name: current problem evidence
evidence_requirements.purpose: Support the physical model facts used in this run.

procedure: Inventory current input files and user statements without importing facts from earlier cases.
Separate physical model facts from algorithm and runtime configuration.
Attach a source reference to each established fact.
Turn unresolved necessary facts into concise user questions.
Label any temporary engineering assumption and state how it affects interpretation.
tool_guidance: Use parsers or inspection code generated for the current input format.
Prefer direct extraction from the current source over manual transcription.
